scope: publicly verified bibliographic/abstract-level evidence registry — NOT numerical benchmarks
purpose: Source-reported independent observations, NOT solver input, calibration, nor proof of specimen-specific matching.
rule: Never load observed values into prediction solver or infer correspondence C from phase labels and unrelated lattice metrics.
rules: No source record may be passed into the solver as a correspondence, orientation matrix or predicted twin/habit answer.
Martensite-martensite twin planes are not austenite-martensite habit planes.
Records from distinct compositions/specimens cannot be merged as a specimen-matched benchmark.
If paired lattice metrics, exact C, indexed variant frame, uncertainty and observed plane are missing, report NOT_COMPARABLE rather than match.

sources.missing_for_blind_3d: specimen-matched complete metric, explicit C, per-interface measured 3D Cartesian normals, uncertainty, parent/product sample orientations and preregistration

records.not_comparable_reason: Only qualitative twin-plane families and OR correspondences accessible; no complete paired C, indexed branch/source gauge, numeric measurement uncertainty.
Phase-specific structural evidence; no full indexed same-specimen twin/habit and correspondence record in accessible source.
Paper reports nine OR/habit/interface observations, but complete indexed planes and paired C unavailable from accessible abstract.

records.alloy: Cu-Zn-Al, 20.4 wt% Zn and 5.6 wt% Al (NOT Cu-Al-Ni)
records.experiment: Cu-Zn-Al TEM and WLR numerical analysis
records.not_comparable_reason: Different alloy (Cu-Zn-Al), and authors reused lattice metrics from another Cu-Zn-Al specimen. Cross-alloy mathematical benchmark only, never experimental Cu-Al-Ni proof.

distinctions: 2H gamma1' is an orthorhombic martensite structure in the stated conventional setting; do not infer from composition alone.
CuAlNi beta1' can have modified monoclinic 18R stacking; a reduced 6M crystallographic representation must not be identified by name alone with a measured conventional 18R cell.
Observed 2D traces provide only surface intersections and do not determine full 3D habit/twin plane inclinations.
A phase-indexing or diffraction identification paper is not necessarily a quantified twin/habit geometry benchmark.
qualification: Bibliographic source evidence only; not automatically loaded into solver predictions. Specimen-specific quantitative 2H/M18R twin and habit experimental validation NOT ESTABLISHED.
